entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup install` doesn't work with an `--install-path` set to a relative directory #53537
  • *.slnx files not supporting File wildcards #53534
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]Error: Failed to load template from "C:\xxx\microsoft.maui.templates.net10.10.0.20.nupkg(/content/templates/maui-blazor-solution/.template.config/template.json)" displays when running command in CLI for the first time. #53532

Closed

  • Suppressed NuGet warnings resurface in referencing projects since SDK 10.0.200 #53505

PullRequests

Created

  • [dotnet-watch] Use Spectre.Console for target framework selection #53540
  • Avoid redirecting process output #53539
  • Improve support of nuget commands with file-based apps #53535
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'main' #53499
  • Do not include forwarded --target option in build arguments #53503
  • Add SWA agent and skills for Static Web Assets development #53496
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Refactor MTP command #53504
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #53527

Updated

  • Enable Microsoft Testing Platform (MTP) for xUnit v3 tests #53517
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Use OTel for telemetry #53181
    Area-CLI
  • [dotnet run] Fix `NETSDK1005` when project refs different TFMs #53523
  • Replace local ci-analysis skill with arcade-skills plugin #53526
  • Fix CI flakiness: MSB4216 task host failures, dotnet-watch hangs, NuGet errors #53424
    Area-Infrastructure
  • `dotnetup` walkthrough - ux & graphical improvements #53464
  • Migrate test infrastructure from xUnit v2 to xUnit v3 #52930
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53350
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Support `--use-current-runtime` / `--ucr` on `dotnet test` (MTP) #53515
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53510
  • Add Asset Groups support for static web assets #53187
  • Prefer DOTNET_ROOT over directory traversal when finding muxer #53405
  • Add TaskHostFactory tests to guard against regression of #12751 in MSBuild #52405
  • Did you mean prerelease version dnx experience #50939
    stale
